name: UI object morphs through states
description: One product UI element IS the carrier and the protagonist: a white card that becomes the dock, a label, a window, a phone, a notification and a composer (6 states); an app-icon stack whose notification badges count up; a now-playing pill that grows into a card, then a cover, then a ring. It never leaves the frame; each state is the next beat's stage.

recipe.build: One element in the DOM, one GSAP timeline: tween its box (width, height, radius, position) and swap or cross-fade the inner content per state (dock icons, label text, window rows, phone frame, notification, composer). Badges are numeric tweens (0 to 1,684) with a seeded easing; the 'o' of a word may be the badge. Every state change lands on a music event; 5 to 6 states in 50 s, each held 2 to 6 s (a typed input or a state change inside the UI proof). Rebuilt in HTML with real copy, never a recording.

use_when: The product has one object that stands for it (an inbox card, a now-playing pill, an app-icon stack, a prompt bar): carry it through the whole film instead of cutting between screens. Declare it as the concept's carrier with kind ui-object.
avoid: Do not swap it for a different object between states (it must read as the same thing); no more than 6 states; no persistent step counter or pill chrome; never a screen recording.
